items.title: 字节 Seed 2.1 发布：Pro/Turbo 双模型主打生产力 Agent
items.summary: 字节 Seed 团队 2026-06-23 发布 Seed 2.1 双模型 Pro 与 Turbo，已上线豆包 App、TRAE、火山方舟。Pro 在 GDPval 拿最高分；Computer-Use Agent 在 MobileWorld 取 SOTA、步数减 16%；众测对 Opus 4.6 取 59.1% 胜率。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: neXt Curve 与 Tirias 泼冷水：所谓 Agentic AI PC 不过是 AI PC 换皮
items.summary: Nvidia 在 Computex 推首款 AI PC 芯片 N1X 与 RTX Spark PC，黄仁勋称为 40 年来 PC 重塑，微软 Build 也演示了相关 Surface 新机。但 neXt Curve 与 Tirias 指出，过去两代 PC 已能跑代理负载，N1X 基于 Arm 会与 x86 不兼容。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: Fitbit Air 评测：Google 给 AI 健康教练加了"克制"这道护栏
items.summary: The Verge 评测 Google 新款 Fitbit Air：其 Google Health Coach 不会像同类 AI 健康产品那样动辄给出激进诊断或情绪化推送，而是在睡眠、HRV、压力等指标失常时仅给出克制建议。评测认为 Google 在"AI 健康一片狼藉"的市场里走了一条更保守、更医学化的路线。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: IBM 开源轻量级 Agent 框架 CUGA：内置 20+ 单文件示例
items.summary: IBM 开源轻量级 Agent 框架 CUGA，把规划、执行、工具调用、状态管理压进单一 harness，给工具列表加提示词即可构建 CugaAgent。内置 Plan-Execute-Reflect 循环，AppWorld 与 WebArena 榜单同时第一，含三档推理模式。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.
